summary:
w115 research done; notes.md in the run directory.
All 8 accepted scenario tests (r47 x2, r58 x3, r59 x2, r57 x1) pass today: nothing is red. HEAD 44aff93 already holds the r57, r58, r59 and r47-retire commits; the brief's Base 1ad628 is older.
Open gap: r57 keys the empty session.json by (work-item, stage name). Probe A: with a second run of the same stage that has figures, both stages are named empty and the figured run is marked too (measure_build.py stages_of).
The empty file has no session id, and log start rows carry no run number, so the link to the run directory is open (Q5).
Also found: a commit subject with U+2028 crashes measure initiative (ValueError, measure_build.py:71; not accepted).
Lowercase z and a newline-only session.json are refused; whether they should be is open (Q2, Q3).
measure show does not print the empty naming (Q4).
File set: scripts/measure_read.py, scripts/measure_build.py; tests and feature file only if a scenario is added.
tests-of had no map and none was made, so tests were found by search.
